rules.name: opens as a modal dialog and focuses the close button when asked to open
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)
rules.note: Opens with showModal(). Focus goes to the first [autofocus] element inside the dialog when there is one, otherwise to .modal-close. It also sets the valueless attribute data-page-scrollbar on the dialog when the page shows a vertical scrollbar, and removes it when not.

rules.name: starts leaving on Escape instead of closing at once
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)
rules.note: Escape fires cancel on the dialog; the cancel is prevented, so the dialog stays open while its closing animation runs.

rules.name: closes once the closing animations have finished
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep), animations.ts (animationsSettled)
rules.note: Waits for every animation on the dialog and the panel to settle, then calls dialog.close(); the close event reports the dialog closed.

rules.name: starts leaving when the close button is clicked
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)

rules.name: starts leaving when a press starts and ends on the backdrop
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)
rules.note: Both events must have the dialog element itself as their target, which is the backdrop area outside .modal.

rules.name: stays open when a press starts inside the panel and ends on the backdrop
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)

rules.name: stops leaving and stays open when asked to open again while leaving
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep)

rules.name: wraps Tab from the last tab stop to the first when focus wrapping is on
rules.source: Modal.svelte (send, focusFirst, cancel, closed, keydown, pointerdown, click) and modal-phase.ts (modalStep), focus-wrap.ts (tabStops, wrappedStop)
rules.note: Shift+Tab on the first tab stop moves to the last. Without wrapFocus the browser handles Tab. Tab stops are visible, enabled, focusable elements with a tabindex of 0 or more; an unchecked radio is skipped.
